Roster data

Six seasons are bundled and always playable: 1998, 2001, 2004, 2007, 2015 and 2022. The game only asks about seasons it actually has, so a round never dead-ends. In the background it tries to pull the remaining seasons from the University of Tennessee Athletics roster archive and caches them in your browser — when one arrives it joins the Endless rotation and the player search. Daily always uses a bundled season so everyone gets the same puzzle.

The search list deliberately shows names only — not seasons — so it doesn't reveal whether a suggestion is correct for the year on screen.

Independent fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the University of Tennessee, NCAA, or SEC.
